_comment: Collection-format layouts. -Layout is OPTIONAL; if omitted the engine uses 'Auto', which unions every known drive-root pattern plus the discovery fallback and works for most collections. Name a specific layout only to FORCE a structure or when Auto can't resolve an encoded path (e.g. some Velociraptor collections). Add a new layout by copying a block. Paths use forward or backslashes interchangeably.

Auto.description: Default. Tries all known drive-root locations (top-level drive folders, Velociraptor uploads paths, and the folder itself) + discovery. Announces how it resolved.
Auto.notes: Transparent auto-resolution: prints the drive root it matched and how. Fails loudly if nothing resolves.

Aralez.description: Kaspersky GERT Aralez triage. Raw NTFS metadata + collected dirs under a drive-letter folder (usually C).

KAPE.description: Kroll Artifact Parser and Extractor (--tdest) triage. Files under <host>/<Drive>/... e.g. C%3A/ or C/.
KAPE.notes: KAPE may prefix a machine-name folder; point -HostArtifacts at that machine folder. Drive folders sometimes URL-encoded (C%3A).

CyLR.description: CyLR collection. Artifacts under a per-host folder, drive as 'C'.
CyLR.notes: CyLR zips per host; unzip first and point at the host folder.

Velociraptor.description: Velociraptor triage/collector output. Files under uploads/<accessor>/<Drive>/... (e.g. uploads/ntfs/%5C%5C.%5CC%3A/ or uploads/auto/C:/).
Velociraptor.notes: Velociraptor path encoding varies by artifact. If resolution misses, use -Layout Raw and pass the exact drive folder, or extend driveRoots here.

Raw.description: A raw or mounted C: volume, Windows.old, or any folder that IS the drive root (contains Windows\, Users\, $MFT).
Raw.notes: Use this for mounted images, VSS copies, Windows.old, or when auto layouts miss. Point -HostArtifacts directly at the drive root.
